workaround: Changed gym:serve to vite gym --port 5173 --strictPort (positional root). Verified the dev server starts and serves http://localhost:5173 (HTTP 200).
future_fix: After a major build-tool upgrade, audit ALL CLI invocations in package.json scripts against the new tool help (npx vite --help), not just the build path. Removed flags fail loudly only when the script is run.
